features.name: Four-symbol pay anywhere

features.description: Four or more scatters award 10 free spins where multipliers up to 1,000x accumulate.

review:
The high-powered sequel on a 6x6 grid atop Mount Olympus. The top row starts locked, and each cascade unlocks another spot – 15 tumbles to clear the whole thing. Just four matching symbols pay anywhere, a lower bar than most.

Multipliers can now hit 1,000x and land any time. Four or more scatters give 10 free spins where multipliers build up and apply to wins. The default RTP is 96%, so check the casino's version.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
